significance.value: No-lensing B-mode hypothesis rejected at 97.1% confidence

summary.plain: POLARBEAR measured the B-mode polarization power spectrum of the Big Bang afterglow at sub-degree scales, where gravitational lensing dominates, and found it consistent with the standard model.
summary.technical: POLARBEAR 150 GHz, 25 deg^2 effective area, 3.5 arcmin resolution, multipoles 500 < l < 2100: A_BB = 1.12 +/- 0.61 (stat) relative to the lensing expectation; no-lensing hypothesis rejected at 97.1%.

title: A Measurement of the Cosmic Microwave Background B-Mode Polarization Power Spectrum at Sub-Degree Scales with POLARBEAR
why_it_matters: It was one of the first measurements of the lensing-induced B-mode power spectrum that any search for inflationary B modes must subtract.
